Lubny Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Poltavska oblast, Ukraine

Not demolished. Little further historical information is documented about the Jewish community of Lubny. According to local residents, this cemetery already existed in the 19th century and once covered 4-5 hectares before being gradually demolished and built over with private houses beginning in the 1920s; it appears on a 1941 Soviet military topographic map with a perimeter slightly larger than what survives today. In the past decade, the remaining site was cleared by local authorities and converted into a public park.
